title: builder-machines-move-under-codemonkey
intention: Move the 8 pre-build machines (orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate, verdict) from devices/builder/machines/ to devices/codemonkey/machines/. Remove the builder device entirely. Update all import paths across both repos.
why: Builder was intended as a base class for builders but has no instances and no code of its own — just an empty __init__.py holding 8 machines. Codemonkey is the code's advocate — protective of the codebase, adversarial by default. The pre-build stages are tools codemonkey uses to protect the codebase before a build lands. Akien: 'what's in builder goes into code monkey.' Also clears the proofs_exist finding on builder (a device with no code has no proofs to write).
traces_to: Law 6 — everything has exactly one owner; the pre-build machines belong to the device that advocates for the code
Law 5 — the builder device folder carries no working state, no running history; it is noise at the working surface
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) devices/builder/ still exists after the migration; (2) any import path still references cairn.devices.builder; (3) the pre-build machines lose their existing proofs or validations in the move; (4) codemonkey's charter does not account for the held machines. WRONG INTENT if: the move changes what the machines DO — this is reparenting, not refactoring.
constraints: 8 machines with extensive import graphs — every caller needs its path updated
CairnCommons references (tickets, berths, chart chains) that name builder paths need forwarding or updating
codemonkey's charter needs updating to reflect the held machines
how: 1. Move machines/ from devices/builder/ to devices/codemonkey/machines/. 2. Update all import paths in both repos. 3. Update codemonkey charter to list the held machines. 4. Remove devices/builder/ entirely. 5. Re-seal affected proofs. 6. Verify build inspector clean for the moved components.
watchme: none, because this is a reparenting migration — no runtime behavior changes to watch
